newsitem.title: UK: Kingfisher up on H1 profits, DIY results.
newsitem.headline: Kingfisher up on H1 profits, DIY results.

text.p: Shares in UK retailing group Kingfisher Plc surged in early dealings on Wednesday after the group announced a 47 percent rise in first-half pretax profits to 109.6 million stg, near the upper end of forecasts.
Kingfisher, heading volumes in pre-market trade, gained 7-1/2p or 1.12 percent to 672-1/2p by 0707 GMT. The FTSE 100 index was indicated marginally lower at the time.

"The shares were off on profit-taking yesterday so today's figures, at the top end of expectations, look like a big sigh of relief all round. The news about DIY business and B&Q was encouraging too," one marketmaker said.

Kingfisher said earlier on Wednesday that its home improvement business B&Q recovered "substantially" from the previous year's bad performance. Sales were up 16 percent and earnings up 48 percent, the group said in a statement.
